body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 4 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: An Action or Reaction fills a Core Wound on the target. Response (unopposed): After recording the Wound, suppress that new Wound Condition's numerical penalties until the start of your next turn if non-Critical. The Wound remains.

surges.html: The target resists 1 unit of any remaining forced movement from that Action.
It gains +1 Harmony against the next attack targeting it until the start of your next turn.
